protocol.sample_selection: uniform episode sampling within each task; 3 time phases plus one IO transition anchor if present
protocol.video_source: existing read-only exact training RGB cache
protocol.sampler: standard predict_action; no RTC history guidance

weighting: pose/error means equally weight episodes; digital-output confusion metrics pool target steps
limitations: These samples were used in training: this is in-sample action prediction, not held-out validation.
Teacher-forced recorded observations; no closed-loop robot rollouts or task success measurements.
Two shared noise repeats are used; uncertainty over unseen data and training runs remains unmeasured.
20k to 40k is a weights-only continuation with reset optimizer and recomputed LR schedule; improvement cannot be attributed solely to step count.
